...

How is pricing calculated for the paid plans?

If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member.

Guests are free of charge – but they can only access individual pages they are invited to. In other words, guests won’t be able to see all the team pages under the `Teamspaces` section in the left sidebar.

How do I get charged when I add members to my workspace?

When you add a new member to your workspace, they will use an existing paid seat if you have any available in your workspace. If you do not have any existing available paid seats, your count of paid seats will increase by 1. Changes in membership that occur mid-month will create prorated charges based on the amount of time remaining in the billing cycle when the paid seat was added.

For every member you delete from your workspace, you will open up 1 available paid seat. This means you have the option to exchange members in your workspace without paying any additional costs, as long as your total billable seat count remains the same.

You’ll receive an invoice for any charges accrued by changes in membership on your selected payment method, on the day of the month you initially signed up for your subscription.

Each time your billing period starts (monthly or annual), your count of paid seats will be synchronized so it exactly matches the amount of members present in your workspace.

...

What happens when I change plans?

- Upgrading your plan: Your account will be upgraded and charged immediately. The amount due will be reduced based on the percentage of the billing cycle left at the time the plan was changed.
- Downgrading your plan: Your account will be downgraded at the end of your billing cycle. Learn about how your features may be impacted after a downgrade here →

How do I cancel my paid plan?

Your Notion subscription, annual or monthly, will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel your subscription by going to `Settings` in the left-hand sidebar on a desktop computer, then selecting `Billing`, then `Change plan`. After you cancel, you’ll still have access to all the paid features until the end of your billing cycle.

# Change your plan

## We offer four different pricing plans for every type of user and team. Here, we'll walk through each one and what it means to upgrade or downgrade your workspace.

Note: Plans apply and are billed at the workspace level. You can have multiple workspaces per account, and each of your workspaces can be on a different plan.

For an in-depth guide to billing and payment, read this article →

Notion offers a Free Plan as well as several paid plans. You can compare our plans and see their prices at notion.com/pricing. Plan availability can vary by workspace, so not every plan below may be offered to you. At a glance, our plans are:

- Free Plan: This plan is meant for individuals who want to organize their personal projects and tasks.
- Plus Plan: This plan is great for collaboration within small teams. The Plus Plan may not be available for every workspace.
- Business Plan: This plan allows businesses to work together using Notion AI, with monthly Standard and Select credits per member, and advanced integrations.
- Enterprise Plan: This plan is for larger organizations looking for scalability, advanced controls, and security. It also includes Notion AI with monthly Standard and Select credits per member.

- Organizations with fewer than 100 employees can upgrade to Enterprise from their Notion settings.
- Organizations with more than 100 employees can contact our sales team for more information.

## Questions & Answers

What is Notion used for?

Notion is a connected workspace that brings docs, wikis, projects, and databases together in one place. With Notion AI and custom agents built in, it also helps teams automate repetitive work—like weekly reporting, meeting follow-ups, and onboarding.

Is Notion free to use?

Yes. Notion's free plan includes unlimited pages, Notion AI, and core features like docs, wikis, and databases. Paid plans start at $10 per member per month (billed annually) for teams that need more advanced features, custom agents, and deeper integrations.

title: Meet your AI team | Notion
text:
How much does Notion AI cost? (and what are Notion credits)?

Business and Enterprise plans give each workspace member a set amount of Notion AI credits each month. Additional usage via Notion credits is a separate, workspace-managed balance your admin can turn on so you can keep going once your Standard or Select credits run out.

- Standard credits: Used for work where Notion picks the model for you. Each member gets 1,500 Standard credits a month.*
- Select credits: Used for work where you pick the model yourself, or use a Custom Agent that isn’t funded by your workspace. Each member gets 500 Select credits a month.*

* Your included amount may vary depending on your plan and purchase arrangement.

title: Preços dos planos do Notion: Free, Plus, Business e Enterprise.
text:
Preços dos planos do Notion: Free, Plus, Business e Enterprise.

# Uma ferramenta para administrar a sua empresa.

## Itens essenciais para manter a organização.

### Free

US$ 0 por membro, mensal

Para os usuários organizarem projetos pessoais e de vida.

Inclui:

- Período de teste da IA do Notion principal
- Formulários básicos
- Sites básicos
- Notion Calendar
- Bases de dados, incluindo subtarefas, dependências, propriedades personalizadas e muito mais

### Plus

US$ 10 por membro, mensal

Para profissionais e equipes pequenas trabalharem juntos.

Todos os recursos do Plano Free, mais:

- Período de teste da IA do Notion principal
- Formulários personalizados
- Sites personalizados
- Gráficos
- Blocos colaborativos
- Uploads de arquivos
- Conexões básicas

## O espaço de trabalho de IA para o trabalho que importa.

### Business Recomendado

US$ 20 por membro, mensal

Para empresas em crescimento otimizarem o trabalho em equipe.

Todos os recursos do Plano Plus, mais:

- Agente do Notion
- Anotações IA
- Busca Enterprise Beta
- SAML SSO
- Autorizações detalhadas para de bases de dados
- Verificar qualquer página
- Crie espaços de equipe que não podem ser vistos ou descobertos por ninguém, exceto pelas pessoas que você adicionar. Funcionam muito bem para informações confidenciais, como planejamento da empresa ou avaliações de desempenho.

Espaços de equipe particulares
- Verificação de domínio
- Conexões premium

### Enterprise

Preços personalizados

Para as organizações que desejam atuar com escalabilidade, controle e segurança.

Todos os recursos do Plano Business, mais:

- Retenção zero de dados com provedores de LLM
- Provisionamento de usuário (SCIM)
- Controles e segurança avançados
- Acesse um registro detalhado de atividades relacionadas à segurança da conta do seu espaço de trabalho para identificar possíveis problemas, investigar comportamentos suspeitos e resolver falhas de acesso.

Registro de auditoria
- Gerente de sucesso do cliente
- Conecte-se com ferramentas de SIEM e DLP para centralizar automaticamente os registros de auditoria e definir políticas para detectar conteúdo confidencial em seu espaço de trabalho e disparar ações automatizadas para correção.

Conexões de segurança e conformidade (DLP, SIEM)
- Estabeleça a propriedade do domínio da sua empresa e tome medidas nos espaços de trabalho que pertencem ao seu domínio verificado (solicite transferência, exclusão ou reivindicação de propriedade)

...

Se você fizer o upgrade do espaço de trabalho para um dos planos pagos, cobraremos uma taxa por membro.
